Definition
[Critical points and critical values] ↗ def:frechet-derivative-hilbert-space 1. ch8:8.5.1-def-3\group Critical Point Theory

(i) We say $u \in H$ is a critical point if $I'[u] = 0$.

(ii) The real number $c$ is a critical value if $K_c \neq \emptyset $.
